key_facts.text: The March 3, 2026 security batch includes Python 3.12.13, 3.11.15 and 3.10.20.

source_snapshot.text:
Python 3.12.13, 3.11.15 and 3.10.20 are now available!
Thomas Wouters/March 3, 2026
wsgiref.headers.Headers now rejects C0 control characters in fields, values, and parameters. Upgraded bundled libexpat to 2.7.4 to fix CVE-2026-24515 and CVE-2026-25210. Fixed a use-after-free in ssl when SSL_new() fails.
